mapper.sql: SELECT oi.item_id AS itemId, oi.item_no AS itemNo, oi.order_id AS orderId, o.order_no AS orderNo, o.order_status AS orderStatus, o.store_id AS storeId, st.store_name AS storeName, o.member_id AS memberId, COALESCE(m.real_name, m.nickname) AS memberName, m.mobile AS memberMobile, oi.item_type AS itemType, oi.item_ref_id AS itemRefId, oi.item_name AS itemName, oi.quantity AS quantity, oi.unit_price AS unitPrice, oi.total_price AS totalPrice, oi.discount_amount AS discountAmount, oi.real_amount AS realAmount, oi.grant_card_id AS grantCardId, oi.remark AS remark, oi.create_time AS createTime
mapper.select: ORDER BY oi.create_time DESC, oi.item_id DESC
ORDER BY oi.create_time DESC, oi.item_id DESC

FROM fit_order_item oi INNER JOIN fit_order o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id AND o.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_store st ON st.store_id = o.store_id AND st.del_flag = '0' LEFT JOIN fit_member m ON m.member_id = o.member_id AND m.del_flag = '0' WHERE oi.del_flag = '0' AND oi.item_id = #{itemId} LIMIT 1
